input:
Write 5 emails of category `purchase_order`, one per slot below, each with its label as described in the brief. Every email must be different in sender, organisation, products and wording.

Slots:
1. Bahasa Indonesia, terse, from the lab of a private hospital in Surabaya; PO number in the body; a calendar delivery date; one product line.
2. English. A Lives Group sales rep in Singapore forwards a customer's email to the sales inbox with a one-line note on top ('pls process'); the customer's PO (two lines, PO number, attachment named like a PO PDF) is in the forwarded part.
3. Vietnamese typed WITHOUT diacritics, from a district hospital in Can Tho; PO number; quantity in boxes ('hop'); no delivery date.
4. Thai mixed with English (Thai script plus English product names), formal, from a private lab in Chiang Mai; orders a preventive maintenance visit; has a PO number.
5. English, rambling, from procurement at a Malaysian hospital: accepts an earlier quotation and says please proceed; mentions budget approval and an earlier 'plan' in the quoted history, but this message is a firm order with a PO number.

emails.body:
Dear Sales Team,

Hope you are well and that the long weekend treated you nicely. Thank you for your quotation QT-26-0388 dated 2 March. Our finance committee finally approved the budget last Thursday so we are happy to accept the quotation as is. Please proceed with the order: our PO number is HSK/PO/2026/1190 (copy attached). Kindly deliver the Refrigerated Benchtop Centrifuge, 2 units, to our Lab Block at Hospital Seri Kenanga, Shah Alam, and please arrange the Installation and Validation Service together with it, 1 job. We would like everything by 29 May 2026 if possible, as the lab renovation will be done by then.

Any issue, just call me.

Best regards,
Nurul Aisyah binti Rahman
Procurement Executive, Hospital Seri Kenanga
Tel: 03-5544 8821

On Mon, 23 Feb 2026 at 10:05, Lee Wei <lee.wei@livesgroup.example> wrote:
> Noted on your plan to buy 2 centrifuges in Q2 once the budget is approved. We will send a quotation shortly.
> Regards, Lee Wei
emails.gist: Malaysian hospital accepts an earlier quotation and firmly orders 2 centrifuges plus installation under a PO number; the earlier plan in the quoted history is superseded.
